description: TY2025 single with AGI −$66,000 (wages $90,000, interest $100,000, Schedule C loss $256,000): medical expenses $10,000 and a federally declared disaster loss $3,000 are deductible in full, never more (the floors read the negative AGI as zero), and $2,000 of cash gifts get no deduction because the 60% limit on a negative contribution base is zero (§ 170(b)(1)(G); the excess carries over under § 170(d)). Reading the base as negative gave a charitable deduction of −$39,600. Itemized: SALT $5,000 + $10,000 + $3,000 = $18,000.
